'''Mutated Geonosians''' were a [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], developed before the [[Third Galactic War|new conflict]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[Darth Malora]].

==Biology and appearance==
Created around [[3628 BBY]] by [[Darth Malora]], the [[mutant]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] were made from several [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;Geonosians, [[Acklay/Legends|Acklays]], [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and [[Melitto/Legends|Melitto]]&mdash; in a combination of [[Bioengineering/Legends|genetic engineering]] and [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. The original Geonosians in the experiment were bought from a secretive group of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hutt gourmands|gluttons]] as adult [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] or in egg or larva forms.<ref name="CX" />

The [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]] were developed to be self-sustaining warriors and hard to eradicate<ref name="CX2" /> with thick [[Armor/Legends|armored]] carapaces, rapid [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]], and heightened sensory capabilities. The mutated Geonosians gained in strength but were removed of most of their [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]], with just enough to operate light weaponry such as [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].<ref name="CX" />

==History==
The Mutated Geonosians were deployed by Darth Malora during the [[Invasion of Ossus]] against the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Colony|colony]] but eventually they turned rogue attacking the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] forces as well as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and those of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] reinforcements.

The Mutated Geonosians established their [[Mutated Geonosian hive|nest]] in the mountains, under the rule of the [[Mutated Geonosian queen]].
